name: Workday Adaptive Planning
summary: Workday Adaptive Planning is an enterprise planning platform for budgeting, forecasting, reporting and scenario modeling, with shareable what-if scenarios inside a governed model. The product page shows no prices and offers a free trial, a demo and a sales contact.

facts.text: The overview page lists no prices or plan tiers and shows Free Trial, Request a Demo and Contact Sales buttons.
The page's FAQ says Adaptive supports personal and shareable what-if scenarios inside a governed model.
The page describes variance analysis in natural language and says plans, actuals and operational data sit in one governed model.
The page cites ISO/IEC 42001 certification for Workday's AI management system, which is not a SOC report.

plans.name: Adaptive Planning
plans.notes: No prices published on the overview page; the footer links to Subscriptions and Flex Credits without describing them
